items.title: Enable seccomp filtering
items.rationale: Seccomp reduces syscall surface and limits the effect of application-level compromise on the host kernel boundary.
actions: Set seccompProfile.type to RuntimeDefault at minimum.
Use Localhost profiles for stricter workloads if validated.
Test the runtime profile against the sandbox process tree before production rollout.
items.snippet:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: REPLACE_ME
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: cua
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
      - name: REPLACE_ME
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 10001
          runAsGroup: 10001
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop: ["ALL"]
          seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault

items.title: Remove setuid/setgid binaries from the image
items.rationale: Setuid and setgid binaries create extra privilege-escalation paths even when the container is otherwise hardened.
actions: Remove unnecessary setuid/setgid binaries from the image.
Prefer distroless or minimal base images where possible.
Verify no operational tooling depends on privilege-granting helpers.
items.snippet: Rebuild the image without unnecessary setuid/setgid helpers.

items.title: Disallow privilege escalation
items.rationale: allowPrivilegeEscalation=false prevents gaining more privilege through setuid binaries or similar execution paths.
actions: Set allowPrivilegeEscalation: false.
Remove setuid/setgid binaries not required by the workload.
Rebuild the image if privilege-granting tools are bundled by default.

  namespace: default

  podSelector:

templates.service_account:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: sandbox-sa
  namespace: default
automountServiceAccountToken: false
templates.kyverno_policy:
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: sandbox-restricted
spec:
  validationFailureAction: Audit
  rules:
  - name: require-restricted-security-context
    match:
      resources:
        kinds:
        - Pod
    validate:
      message: Enforce restricted securityContext for sandbox workloads.
      pattern:
        spec:
          containers:
          - securityContext:
              allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
              readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
              seccompProfile:
                type: RuntimeDefault
templates.gatekeeper_template:
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
  name: k8srequiredsandboxsecurity
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names:
        kind: K8sRequiredSandboxSecurity
  targets:
  - target: admission.k8s.gatekeeper.sh
    rego: |
      package k8srequiredsandboxsecurity
      violation[{"msg": msg}] {
        input.review.kind.kind == "Pod"
        not input.review.object.spec.containers[_].securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem
        msg := "Sandbox pods must set readOnlyRootFilesystem=true"
      }
